message.content:
A vertical illustration features three men on a mustard-yellow background. At the top, a red rectangle and text "TEMPO 55" appear in red. The headline reads "DAN PEMENANGNYA ADALAH...". Smaller text below mentions "Presiden Prabowo" and "Kepala Polri." 

In the foreground, a man in a white long-sleeved shirt stands centrally. He has a round face and is depicted in a caricature style. He points his right index finger toward himself while his left arm is raised high. His left wrist is gripped by the right hand of the man to the right. This second man wears a gray short-sleeved uniform with shoulder epaulettes featuring four gold stars and a name tag. He smiles broadly, holding a thumbs-up with his left hand. To the left, a third man in a dark suit, tie, and glasses stands with his right hand on his hip, looking forward with a neutral expression. 

The bottom includes a barcode, QR code, and text "18-24 MEI 2026," "RP 60.000," and "TEMPO.CO/MINGGUAN." The figures are rendered with black outlines and block shading.
